prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete photorealistic tall industrial harbor floodlight mast, about 12 meters high. Slender tapered galvanized steel pole, substantial square bolted base plate and small access hatch near bottom. At top a horizontal steel crossarm carrying four rectangular industrial floodlight housings on pivot brackets, angled slightly downward toward viewer. Glass lenses warm pale amber but unlit, clearly distinguishable from dark charcoal housings. Salt weathering and subtle rust only at fasteners. Entire mast including all fixtures and base visible in portrait three-quarter studio view with margin, neutral diffuse lighting, plain light gray background. No ground slab, no scenery, no text or logos. Structurally plausible single pole.
